name: Lucky Rainbow Fruit Kabobs with Marshmallow "Clouds"

instructions.primary_message: This recipe contains steps that can be done by smaller hands! You know your child (and their cooking abilities) best, so get them involved where you feel comfortable. Have fun!
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 kiwifruit
1 mango
113 g red grapes
½ (170 g) pkg raspberries

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and halve kiwis lengthwise, then slice each half crosswise into 3 half-moons (giving you 12 pieces total). Place on a plate.
Peel mango and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides; large dice the flesh (aiming for 12 pieces total). Add to the plate with the kiwi, along with grapes and raspberries.
Thread fruit onto skewers in a rainbow pattern: raspberry, mango, kiwi, grape. End with a marshmallow "cloud."
Arrange fruit skewers on a platter, share, and enjoy!
